page_title: MON 2-2 MAI | B. Monchengladbach v Mainz 06/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Sven Jablonski is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) misses a big chance! He fires the ball high over the crossbar from inside the 6-yard box after the ball rebounded to him.
90+6' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall charges down the ball.

90+5' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Sven Jablonski blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. A free kick to B. Monchengladbach.
90+2' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
89' Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Moritz Nicolas has no trouble gathering it.

88' 2 - 2 Goal! Great link up play between Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) and Nathan Ngoumou gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the top left corner. 2:2.
86' Bo Svensson is forced to make a change. Tom Krauss is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Dominik Kohr (Mainz).
86' Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach) serves up a nice cross, but Robin Zentner punches the ball away.
85' B. Monchengladbach players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
84' Tom Krauss (Mainz) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
83' Tom Krauss (Mainz) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
82' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
81' Sven Jablonski shows a yellow card to Kouadio Kone (B. Monchengladbach) for his blatant foul.
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Merveille Papela (Mainz) is coming onto the pitch as Anthony Caci cannot continue after picking up an injury.
79' Luca Netz goes off the pitch and Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) comes on.
79' Gerardo Seoane prepares a substitution. Rocco Reitz is replaced by Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach).

79' A cross following the corner kick finds its way to Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) inside the box and he manages to steer it to the middle of the target. He is about to start celebrating a goal, but Robin Zentner makes a save in the nick of time and maintains the current score.
79' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
78' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the roof of the net, but Robin Zentner is prepared and leaps to thwart him.
78' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner but it's cleared.

77' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the top left corner. Robin Zentner shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
75' 1 - 2 Aymen Barkok (Mainz) latched on to a sweet pass and coolly slotted the ball inside the right post.
72' Aymen Barkok (Mainz) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Moritz Nicolas is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
70' Substitution. Aymen Barkok (Mainz) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jae-Sung Lee walks off.
70' Bo Svensson has decided to substitute Brajan Gruda and he is replaced by Anwar El-Ghazi (Mainz).

70' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the bottom left corner. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
69' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

68' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed into the top right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to B. Monchengladbach.
67' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) sends a long ball in, but Robin Zentner comfortably gathers the ball.
66' Stefan Bell (Mainz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Sven Jablonski had an easy-decision to make.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alassane Plea leaves the pitch and Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) comes on.
64' Gerardo Seoane decides to make a substitution. Jordan Siebatcheu will be replaced by Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach).
64' Gerardo Seoane has decided to make a change. Kouadio Kone (B. Monchengladbach) replaces Florian Neuhaus.
63' A precise cross towards the edge of the box was latched onto by Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz). He outjumped the defence and produced a powerful header which went a whisker wide of the right post.
63' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) takes a cheeky throw-in and sets up a counter-attack for his team.
61' Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
56' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) has tested the patience of referee Sven Jablonski and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
54' Surely that's handball by one of the Mainz players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!

53' He should have scored! Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Moritz Nicolas makes an easy save.
52' A spell of possession for B. Monchengladbach in an attempt to control the game.
49' Good movement by Danny da Costa (Mainz), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
48' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
46' The whistle blows and Sven Jablonski starts the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Anthony Caci (Mainz) latches on to a precise cross on the edge of the box and strikes the ball goalwards. However, it whistles wide of the right post so the goalkeeper can relax.
45' Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
44' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
44' Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
43' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
40' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
39' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
38' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) will deliver the corner kick.
35' The corner is swung in but B. Monchengladbach can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

34' Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the roof of the net that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
33' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) sends a chip pass into the box, but Robin Zentner is quickest to intercept the ball.
33' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
32' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
28' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Robin Zentner, who makes a comfortable save.

24' 1 - 1 Brajan Gruda (Mainz) scores an incredible goal! He receives a pass, makes some space for himself and unleashes a long-range thunderbolt of a shot past the goalkeeper into the top right corner.
24' Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) takes a short corner kick.

22' 1 - 0 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Franck Honorat is pounced on by Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach). His close-range strike flashes past Robin Zentner and into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
20' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) meets a cross inside the box, but he is unable to produce an accurate header and it goes just over the bar.
20' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
19' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) collects a pass and has an effort from distance which is blocked.
19' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) takes it short.

14' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) picks up a cross inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the right side of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Robin Zentner, who pulls off a stunning save!
14' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
13' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.
9' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
7' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
7' Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
5' B. Monchengladbach hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
2' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
1' An attempted cross from Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) is cleared.
1' The first half has just begun.
Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) takes a long run up and launches the free kick towards goal from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall bravely blocks the effort.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Mainz will have the kick-off.
Sven Jablonski will supervise the game today.
